text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [IUTchIV] §3 calls a type of mathematical object a species and a functor between species a mutation; the log-theta-lattice is a mutation-history. The toolkit implements each species as a C struct and each mutation as a function. Boxes are species, arrows are
